dek: Trump signed a Friday EO waiving some sanctions/tariffs on Russian energy trade (60-day evaluation window; diesel deal: ~2.3M bbl this month rising to ~7.6M/mo); Brent slid to ~$107-108 but stayed elevated on Hormuz risk. Kpler: confirmed Hormuz flows 10.17M b/d 7-day avg, 41% below prewar…
sources: WSJ (oil futures notes), Kpler (flow data), UKMTO, CBS (refinery-target reporting), Truth Social (Trump)
fault_line: Sanctions waiver for Russia while Hormuz burns - coherent strategy to lower oil prices, or incoherence that rewards Moscow? Pocketbook hook: $110 oil vs the waiver.

sections.what_happened: Trump signed a Friday EO waiving some sanctions/tariffs on Russian energy trade (60-day evaluation window; diesel deal: ~2.3M bbl this month rising to ~7.6M/mo); Brent slid to ~$107-108 but stayed elevated on Hormuz risk. Kpler: confirmed Hormuz flows 10.17M b/d 7-day avg, 41% below prewar baseline; IMF PortWatch: 2 transits Oct 11 vs 85/day baseline. UKMTO reported a tugboat attack near UAE Sunday. WSJ: Iran is providing Ansar Allah intelligence/targeting assistance for Saudi attacks.
sections.what_verified: WSJ (multiple notes: waiver, Kpler data, tugboat, Ansar Allah intel aid); Mandatory.com on EO terms; straits.live (Brent $110.02, 2 transits vs 85/day baseline); Mandatory + CBS on CBS-reported refinery/power-plant strike consideration.
sections.what_disputed: Prior sanctions remain in effect; Rubio says 60-day evaluation. Sanctions-waiver easing Russian supply vs Hormuz physical disruption are opposing forces - analysts split (Naeem Aslam: retreat on supply expectations; UBS: attacks keep floor).
sections.why_matters: The two-way oil war: Trump eases Russia sanctions to bring prices down while Hormuz runs 41% below capacity and a tugboat gets hit near the UAE - the numbers, the flows, and who wins.
sections.context: Background: Shipping/energy update: Trump Friday EO waives some Russia sanctions/tariffs; Brent ~$108-110; Hormuz flows 41% below prewar (Kpler); UKMTO tugboat attack near UAE; WSJ: Iran aiding Ansar Allah targeting (extends 2000-04, 2100 series, 2200-03)
